title: Chapter 6168: Immortal Slays Heaven

Chapter 6168: Immortal Slays Heaven

Chapter 6168: Immortal Slays Heaven

“Just go before it is too late.” Emperors stared at Transcendent and shared a consensus.

“Yes, Immortal Suppression will go down today, it’s the right time to leave.” Others nodded in agreement.

The unshakable dynasty was doomed today. Only one emperor was left - Transcendent. They felt sorry for him due to his peerless talent. Being buried here was not worth it since he could become an overlord.

“Surviving is the most crucial thing, don’t throw your life away.” A desolate god whispered.

Transcendent had tried his best to no avail. Sacrificing himself was unnecessary.

“Leave the battlefield to Immortal Suppressor. If Immortal Suppressor can win, there’s no need for him to die here, the opposite applies too.” An emperor gazed deeper into the dynasty.

“Exactly.” Others agreed, wanting Transcendent to take the wise way out since Li Qiye had given permission.

“Sir, I was born here and will die here if fate dictates so. I do not fear death and prefer to be buried with the dynasty. Moreover, it is an honor to be killed by you.” Transcendent responded with a respectful bow.

Others didn’t know what to think. Transcendent - a potential overlord - chose to die when he could just leave.

“A manly decision.” Someone commented.

“This is how emperors should be.” Another said: “Uniquely talented. Arrogant, but courageous.”

“He’s a role model for all cultivators.” One emperor said.

Everyone gazed at the magnificent emperor, still looking as proud as ever. His personality matched his supreme appearance.

“Words and actions in harmony, I truly admire him.” Many were willing to pay their respect despite not being suppressed by his aura.

“Any sect would love to have a member like him.” An ancestor said: “Such selfless loyalty.”

“Well said, fulfilling one’s duty in a manner benefitting that of an emperor, excellent.” Li Qiye said: “Fine, I will kill you and destroy your dynasty today.”

Listeners felt their throats being squeezed by his nonchalant declaration. It was as if their neck was about to break.

“This is the end of an era.” Those who looked at Li Qiye couldn’t help but shudder, feeling cold all over.

“Great, let me witness your power so I can die with no regrets!” Transcendent roared and a dao path emerged beneath his feet. It flashed brightly with images of tribulations.

This was a path of no return - either crossing to the other shore successfully or dying along the way.

“The limit path!” Emperors and desolate gods understood the implications.

“He’s unleashing all of his power to fuel the formation!” A desolate god elaborated.

“Heaven slay!” He became ethereal as six dao appeared amidst the sword domain.

Each dao pulsed with the immortal affinity. Staring at them was akin to staring at the mysteries of the true immortals - a way into surpassing the high heaven.

“The immortal path!” Upon seeing such phenomena and feeling a special energy, everyone felt they were embarking on the path toward immortal ascension. This was something beyond the imperial realm.

“Immortal Slays Heaven!” Transcendent bellowed and made his move.

“Clank!” The immortal sword soared to the sky and activated a tribulation.

As he swung, the lightning-imbued sword cut the sky and split the tribulation apart to everyone’s horror.

Cultivators feared tribulations but this blade was able to cut through it.
